# Changelog

## [0.2.7] - 2026-10-24

### Added

- Added read-only bundle role discovery and cast-readiness checks for explicit and default speech roles
- Added portable VoiceFolio-managed reference bindings with transcript-aware Kokoro and AkinVox profile workflows
- Added bounded structured diagnostics for render-time failures across direct, document, book, and bundle results
- Added bounded engine-session residency and crash-safe cross-platform render-lock recovery with resumable partial outputs

- Fixed voice-level option normalization and preserved Qwen3 seed options only when explicitly set
- Fixed bundle-root validation for paths that resolve to canonical .ssmd-bundle directories
